name: UGC 7903 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 7903, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc07903-hubble
story: A dwarf irregular galaxy, one of the nearby galaxies Hubble visited in an effort to resolve the brightest stars of every known nearby galaxy and measure how far away each one lies.

claims.text: UGC 7903 is a dwarf irregular galaxy (type dIrr); PGC 42832
Hubble observed it in a program to image every known nearby galaxy, resolving the brightest stars to measure distances
